open_science_requirements: Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences including digital ones (e.g. generative AI), and foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and when applicable innovation and entrepreneurship, as well as good scientific conduct such as research integrity. (CC-10, Scope – Training activities, HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)

Fellowships should empower fellows to pursue a career in research and prepare them for increased research collaboration and information-sharing made possible by new digital technologies (e.g. collaborative tools, FAIR data management, societal engagement and citizen science). (CC-11, Scope – Training activities, HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)

Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences including digital skills (e.g. generative AI), foster Open Science culture, knowledge valorisation, research integrity, and where applicable innovation and entrepreneurship. Fellows must be prepared for digital collaboration, FAIR data management, and societal engagement. (SR-06, Scope – Training activities, HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)

A Career Development Plan must be established jointly by the supervisor(s) and the researcher, covering research objectives, training and career needs, transferable skills, teaching, publications, and participation in open science events. (SR-07, Scope – Career Development Plan, HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)
